title: HTML export escapes cell link, image, style and arrow properties; the non-SPA CSP carries form-action and an img-src limited to self

criteria.given: a DATA_CELL whose properties carry quote and markup payloads (image, style, link, arrow, and the datadiv raw/position attributes)
criteria.then: the rendered export HTML contains no unescaped element or attribute introduced by those payloads; a property value can only appear as escaped text (renderer test with the issue's payloads)

criteria.given: link and image cell properties whose URL scheme is not http or https
criteria.then: the property is dropped and no URL of another scheme reaches the rendered HTML
the default non-SPA Content-Security-Policy carries form-action 'self' and an img-src that does not allow arbitrary hosts
